The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
1A
THE CONSTITUTION OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPULIC OF SRI LANKA
Notification

IT is hereby notified that I acting under Paragraph (2) of Article 45 of the Constitution of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka, determined that withe effect from January 01, 2016, the assignment of Duties and Functions to theDeputy Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs appointed under Paragraph (1) of Article 44 ofthe Constitution, to be as indicated in the Schedule given below :
JOHN E. A. AMARATUNGA M. P.,Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs.Colombo,06th January 2016.SCHEDULE
DEPUTY MINISTER OF TOURISM DEVELOPMENT AND CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS AFFAIRS
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS
01. Formulation, Monitoring and Evaluation of Projects/Programmes in regard to tourism promotional activitiesin consulation with the Minister.

02. Ensure success of the proposed registration process of “Inform sector” engaged in tourism related activitiesillegally (eg. Hotels, Restaurants, Bars, Guides, Travel Agents, etc.) Island wide, so that by June 2016 theybecome formal entities and to overlook this process along with Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.
03. Review and monitor the progress in the implementation of domestic tourism promotional programmes.
04. Formulation, Monitoring and Evaluation of programmes implemented at divisional level in relation to ChristianReligious Affairs.
05. Matters relating to the development and regulation of tourist hotels and also emphasis on hotel classificationexercise.
06. Close rapport with and review, monitor and evaluate the affaris of the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authorityand ensure productivity.
07. Matters relating to the training the human resources required in the tourism field.
08. Any other duty or fuction that may be entrusted by the Minister from time to time.
